Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 150. Category: technique. “Other” Ki Techniques.

Rank 3 technique
Prerequisites: Charge
Casting Time: Special
Range: Self
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Other
By taking a moment to center your energy you can
restore your Ki.
Recharges 30+wis mod ki if used as an Action, or
3d10+wis mod Ki as an Bonus action.
